augmentation.gain_jitter: independent per-image multiplicative gain (1 + N(0, 0.1)) on left and right AFTER normalisation; sigma=0.1 (ScaledCroppedKitti jitter=0.1 default)

intervention.disparity_scaling: disp[disp > 0] *= sx with sx = 512/w (REALISED horizontal factor, not sampled s)
intervention.draw: one draw per sample: s = exp(uniform(log(0.7), log(1.7))) (logUniform 0.7-1.7)
intervention.window: w = round(512/s), h = round(256/s); (y, x) uniform over valid top-left positions; defensively clamped to source frame

augmentation.op_order: crop -> resize -> ImageNet normalise -> gain jitter (ARM-V order)

checkpoint_selection.best_rule: lowest val EPE (m.epe) over the monitored epochs -> OUT_DIR/p2a_best.pth (torch.save {model, config})
checkpoint_selection.final: OUT_DIR/p2a_final.pth at end of run + OUT_DIR/p2a_record.json (config, history, sha256s, scale-draw stats, software)
checkpoint_selection.monitor: validate() every 5 epochs and on the final epoch: first 10 hailo_val scenes, full-frame, NO scaling; metrics via disparity_metrics (EPE, D1)

dataset_manifest.frames: _10 only (reference frame; frame 11 has no disparity GT), sorted

device_precision.device: cuda if torch.cuda.is_available() else cpu (P2A seed-0 record: cuda)

disparity_convention.no_data_value: 0 means no ground truth; never treated as disparity zero
disparity_convention.scale: raw 16-bit PNG divided by 256.0 (official KITTI convention; Hailo /255 deviation NOT used; Kitti2015Stereo default disparity_scale=256.0)
disparity_convention.training_scaling: after NEAREST resize, disp[disp > 0] *= sx (realised horizontal factor)

image_dims.source_frame_rule: pad_and_crop: zero-pad bottom/right up to 368x1232, then top-left crop (for KITTI: 7 bottom rows + 10 right cols removed, no padding)

integrity_guard.policy: ABORT BEFORE TRAINING (before any optimizer step) if all_ok is false; reference phase1/runs/arm_v/arm_v_best.pth

loss.name: masked smooth L1 (src.losses.disparity.masked_smooth_l1)
loss.returns: (loss, valid_pixel_count); empty-mask batch returns zero with gradient path (no crash)

normalisation.when: after crop/resize, before gain jitter; on 0-255 RGB

scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=EPOCHS); scheduler.step() once per epoch; string recorded as 'cosine annealing to 0 over 200 epochs'

split.enforcement: asserts: len 160/40, first/last names, disjoint name sets ('train/eval overlap!'); train_base split='hailo_calib' only enters optimizer loop
